changelog:
What's new in v5.0.10:
- SHANEX-branded setup with no Inno name in the filename or setup title.
- Setup checks running processes without WMI, fixing the Windows Management Instrumentation verification error.
- Interactive removal of older NSIS/MSI installations; choose No if asked to remove license data.
- Eight material themes, natural dark palettes, accent color switcher and compact V4 customer cards.
- WhatsApp browser stability and standalone job-save fixes.
- Force Select improvements and session/PDF performance updates.
Legacy migration, sustained live WhatsApp and physical printer acceptance remain pending. Installer is unsigned.
